knowledge._source: Everything Andy has read. Staff drop files into the Google Drive folder; sync pulls them in.
knowledge._syncHour: UTC hour for the nightly Drive sync. Null disables it and leaves sync to the button.

chunk._targetChars: Chunks are sized for retrieval, not for reading: big enough to carry a whole idea, small enough that twenty of them fit in one answer.

embeddings._provider: 'voyage' (recommended, Anthropic's partner), 'openai', or 'none'. With 'none' Andy still works: retrieval falls back to keyword search alone, which is worse at paraphrase but needs no extra account.

retrieval._hybrid: Keyword and vector search each miss things the other catches, so both run and the ranks are fused. Keyword finds the exact gift name; vectors find 'room is dead' in a document that says 'low engagement'.

answer._maxToolRounds: How many times Andy may search or look up data before it has to answer with what it has.
answer._historyTurns: Follow-up questions in a Discord thread carry this many previous turns.

creatorHealth._baseUrl: The creator-health service. Andy reads a creator's real numbers, open cases and ranked causes from it, so advice is about this creator rather than creators in general.

discord._gateway: The Gateway connection is what lets staff just @Andy in a channel. Slash commands work without it.
discord._allowedChannels: Empty means Andy answers mentions anywhere it can see. Add channel ids to pen it in.
discord._ephemeralByDefault: true makes /andy answers private to whoever asked. Public answers teach the whole team at once, so this is false.
